use_when.text: Use it at the bottom of every main screen in the Mobile App.
Set Active to the tab for the current screen.
Keep the five tabs and their order the same on every screen.
Set the width to Fill so it spans the screen.
Keep the bottom padding for the home indicator.

dont_use_when.text: Do not use it on the Public Website or Back Office. Use Top Nav or Sidebar.
Do not add or remove tabs.
Do not show it inside step-by-step flows, where it can pull people out mid-task.
Do not recolour it outside the bound tokens.

best_practice.text: Keep each tab label to one short word.
Tapping the active tab again should scroll its screen back to the top.

a11y.text: Renders a <nav aria-label="Main"> holding a <ul> with one <a> per tab.
Tab icons have no Label, so they are aria-hidden; the visible label names the tab.
Use a nav element with aria-label="Main", with one link or button per tab.
Set aria-current="page" on the active tab.
Each tab is at least 48 px tall and 64 px wide.
Mark the icons aria-hidden="true". The label names the tab.
Labels are above 4.5:1. The active icon is 7.5:1 on the pill in Light and 8.0:1 in Dark.
